args.title: Correct the password reset email link to use the public URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email currently generates a link using the localhost URL, which prevents users from accessing the reset page. This change will ensure that the email uses the correct public URL, allowing users to reset their passwords successfully.
